held_input_fault_injection.method: Normal real-device paired session; diagnostic Win32 SendInput batch inserts only Ctrl DOWN or MOVE+LEFTDOWN, pauses 4000 ms, returns actual partial count; unmodified Release unwinds input. Independent interactive Windows thread samples actual state every nominal 10 ms.
held_input_fault_injection.causality_limit: Release follows partial-injection failure, not proof of network detector directly releasing a naturally held key. Ordinary product uses atomic DOWN/UP batches.

limitations: HDC does not independently expose Android runtime API, PID, same Activity identity, lifecycle callbacks or logcat crash logs.
Diagnostic held-key scenarios supplement final normal product acceptance; no claim of naturally held remote keys in the atomic-action protocol.
